name: Kaspaland
summary: Neon metropolis of holo-ads, aerial traffic, underground markets, and the Minecore plants below.
bodyMarkdown:
**Kaspaland** is the primary urban setting of Krex's Chronicles: cyber skyscrapers, holographic billboards, autonomous drones, and streets dense with crypto commerce. From [[location:kasparex|Kasparex]]'s tower the **cybernetic sky** can glitch when higher powers interfere.

Beneath the city, **[[location:minecore-complex|Minecore]]** drills into unstable diamond veins. Treat the [Minecore game](/games/minecore) as the same world at industrial depth.
visualStyle: Cyberpunk neon, decentralized ad layers, electric veins of light
roleInStory: The city Krex protects; stage for gangs, listings, and sky anomalies.
secretsMarkdown: Whispers of rare crystal chambers and reactor cores tie to Minecore lore beneath the streets.

name: Kasparex
summary: Hidden high-security database center and tower - lifeblood of KREX Token intelligence.
bodyMarkdown: **Kasparex** is [[character:krex|Krex]]'s concealed command core in Kaspaland: holo-displays, encrypted feeds, elevators to the [[location:kasparex-rooftop|rooftop]], and the mainframe that **Null Gang** and later **Silent Protocol** target. It is both physical architecture and symbolic heart of the KREX network.
visualStyle: Sleek metal corridors, cyan holo UI, living-circuit elevator shafts
roleInStory: HQ for Krex's team; first battlefield against the Null Gang.

name: Kasparex Rooftop
summary: Night vantage over Kaspaland where the cybernetic sky showed a deliberate glitch.
bodyMarkdown: After the Silent Protocol's warning, Krex rides the transparent elevator to the **rooftop** for perspective. Here he observes **aerial traffic** and, critically, **glitches in the cybernetic sky** - encrypted atmospheric projection warping as if something tried to break through. ARIA cross-links the anomaly to [[location:forgotten-blocks|forgotten blocks]] data.
visualStyle: Open air, cool night wind, horizon of neon and holo-ads
roleInStory: Revelation that network war may alter perceived reality above the city.

name: The Forgotten Blocks
summary: Obsolete Kaspa ledger fragments - early history, discarded txs - where a cryptic message waited.
bodyMarkdown: The **forgotten blocks** are metaphorical and technical edge territory: abandoned early-network history and fragmented trails. A masked signature and message - *Find me before they do* - draw [[character:krex|Krex]] and [[character:aria|ARIA]] into contact with [[character:silent-protocol|The Silent Protocol]].
visualStyle: Abstract data archaeology, broken chain fragments, archival dust
roleInStory: Plot hinge between Kaspa's past and an active hidden war.

name: Minecore Complex
summary: Krex's subterranean industrial network beneath Kaspaland: plants, grid load, and diamond refinement.
bodyMarkdown:
The **Minecore Complex** is the official game layer of Krex's Chronicles: a deep industrial stratum where [[character:krex|Krex]], [[character:vector|Vector]], and [[character:aria|ARIA]] coordinate extraction from unstable **diamond veins**.

Operators deploy tiered plants from [[location:minecore-standard-plant|Standard rigs]] up to the [[location:minecore-dominion-complex|Dominion Complex]]. Crew NFTs, battery pillars, fabrication modules, and grid efficiency determine whether a cycle completes or collapses under load.

This is not spectacle mining. Minecore is **infrastructure**: the force that keeps Kaspaland lit when Null Gang erasure and Silent Protocol glitches threaten the surface.

Play the live experience at [Minecore](/games/minecore).
visualStyle: Emerald reactor glow, teal grid HUDs, subterranean steel catwalks
roleInStory: Industrial backbone of Kaspaland; bridge between Chronicles lore and playable extraction.

name: Standard Plant (Minecore)
summary: Entry-tier Minecore rig: one battery pillar, one crew link, reliable baseline output.
bodyMarkdown:
**Standard Plants** are the first footprint in the Minecore grid: affordable, dependable, and built for operators learning the rhythm of charge cycles and maintenance wear.

Lore treats these rigs as the **street-level industrial face** of Krex's network - where new crew prove they can keep a single pillar stable before Vector authorizes tier upgrades.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): basic mining operations, one battery pillar, one workforce slot.
visualStyle: Compact forge bays, hammer-marked plating, single cyan reactor column
roleInStory: Gateway tier for surface-to-depth operators in the Minecore canon.

name: Premium Plant (Minecore)
summary: Upgraded Minecore infrastructure with dual battery pillars and fabrication modules.
bodyMarkdown:
**Premium Plants** mark the moment an operator stops surviving the grid and starts **shaping** it: dual battery pillars, fabrication hooks, and longer maintenance intervals.

Tessa's stealth workflows sometimes route surplus power from Premium bays into Kasparex failover lines during Null Gang spikes.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): upgraded infrastructure with dual pillars and module slots.
visualStyle: Shielded dual reactors, teal maintenance rails, modular fab arms
roleInStory: Mid-tier industrial anchor when Kasparex needs redundant underground power.

name: Advanced Complex (Minecore)
summary: Industrial-scale Minecore site with three crew links and high rolling diamond caps.
bodyMarkdown:
The **Advanced Complex** is where Minecore lore meets **city-scale logistics**: three staffed crew rows, heavier grid draw, and rolling caps that can feed refinement pools for Hub rewards.

ARIA monitors these sites for Silent Protocol fingerprints in power telemetry.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): industrial-scale mining with three module slots and higher daily ceilings.
visualStyle: Zap-lit catwalks, triple reactor stacks, industrial warning stripes
roleInStory: Primary production tier linking underground extraction to Kasparex intelligence budgets.

name: Industrial Site (Minecore)
summary: Heavy-duty Minecore grid headroom with four crew links and deep daily ceilings.
bodyMarkdown:
**Industrial Sites** span whole cavern wings under Kaspaland: four battery pillars, four crew decks, and maintenance cycles measured in multi-day endurance runs.

Vector's garage schematics often prototype here before surface deployment.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): heavy-duty grid headroom and four staffed crew links.
visualStyle: Massive gantry cranes, orange safety beacons, four-pillar reactor ring
roleInStory: Vector's preferred tier for stress-testing machines that later appear in Chronicles crossovers.

name: Elite Foundry (Minecore)
summary: Five-pillar apex foundry for dedicated operators with elite rolling caps.
bodyMarkdown:
The **Elite Foundry** is reserved for crews who treat Minecore as **doctrine**, not side income: five reactor pillars, five NFT crew links, and efficiency discipline that Null Gang cannot easily spoof.

Krex uses Foundry output to fund premium chapter unlocks and emergency Kaspa treasury moves.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): five pillars and apex-tier rolling caps.
visualStyle: Crown-lit control spire, gold-teal reactor crown, elite crew decks
roleInStory: High-trust industrial tier tied to premium Chronicles arcs.

name: Dominion Complex (Minecore)
summary: Maximum Minecore facility scale: six pillars, six crew rows, six module slots.
bodyMarkdown:
The **Dominion Complex** is the mythic ceiling of Minecore canon: six pillars, six crew rows, six module slots, and rolling caps that can reshape refinement economics across Kaspaland.

Lore hints that Dominion telemetry once pinged the [[location:forgotten-blocks|forgotten blocks]] during a Silent Protocol flare - proof the deepest rigs touch network history itself.

In [Minecore](/games/minecore): maximum facility scale for dedicated operators.
visualStyle: Landmark-scale reactor cathedral, emerald dominion banners, six-pillar symmetry
roleInStory: Endgame industrial seat of power beneath the metropolis.
